observations.roof: Roof appears intact with clean lines, no visible sagging or missing shingles. Appears to be in serviceable condition, likely 10-15 years old based on the 2000 build date and lack of visible deterioration.

observations.windows_doors: Windows appear intact and operational. Door visible on side entrance looks functional. No broken glass, boarded openings, or obvious failures. Likely original vinyl windows.
observations.yard_landscaping: Yard is maintained with mowed grass. Front yard has deteriorated stone/concrete steps with crumbling edges and vegetation growing through - needs replacement. Deck railings show weathering. Basic landscaping present, no major overgrowth or debris.

Interior is clean and partially updated (flooring, paint) but the golden oak kitchen cabinets and dated fixtures need refreshing to maximize ARV. Budget $16k-32k for cabinet refacing or replacement, updated lighting/hardware, bathroom refresh, and rebuilding those front entrance steps. The bones are solid - this is a paint-and-polish flip, not a systems overhaul.
